decisions.reason: Press-to-dispense operation does not change the existing leak-prevention requirements.
The button interaction does not alter spout location, orientation, construction, appearance, or beverage-quality constraints.

The client asks whether the spouts will be removable and notes the cleaning benefit, but the wording may be either a confirmation question or a narrowing of the existing removable-or-flushable cleaning method.
Press-to-dispense operation does not change the platform height, cup clearance, or mixer fit.
Selecting a press-to-dispense interaction does not necessarily change the existing V1 sourcing policy.
The source establishes button interaction and decoration but does not revise the approved component set or require a new BOM.
The dispensing-button interaction does not alter the required mixing texture, foam quality, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The source decision does not change whisk selection, attachment, positioning, removal, or rotation criteria.
The source discusses removable spouts and dispensing buttons, not bowl removal or swapping.
Press-to-dispense operation does not modify the existing requirements for splash-free mixing.
